questions.q: What does lesson 1 advise about discrimination at work?
a: Follow up on all conflicts and show there's no room for it
questions.why: Lesson 1 says to follow up even on minor conflicts.

questions.q: What is the main message of lesson 2?
a: Work within your own limits to avoid burnout
questions.why: Lesson 2 says overworking isn't productive or healthy.

questions.q: Why might allowing extra hours for one person be a problem?
a: Others may want the same and teams may not cover it
questions.why: Lesson 2 raises fairness and coverage concerns.

questions.q: What causes anxiety for younger workers, per lesson 3?
a: Fear of missing out, fueled by social media
questions.why: Lesson 3 ties FOMO to watching friends online.

questions.q: What helps retain a workforce, per lesson 3?
questions.why: Lesson 3 recommends offering new challenges and positions.
